currentStopNameReview.physicalContinuityReview: P11-22_40 bs4737 / n4737 explicitly retains same-operator 姪浜 and historical 98 Meinohama-Noko route, as a representative rather than separate directional poles. Preserve historical canonical name, archive coordinates and whole-stop scope.

rightsReview.reason: Entire five-section current site conditions explicitly cover jik.nishitetsu.jp; statutory lawful scope is distinguished from reserved expression. Full linking conditions also reviewed: public product links should use the named root pages; exact internal provenance URLs are not a public deep-link feature. No raw page, artwork, clocks, fares, frequencies or full timetable dataset retained. Minimum independently structured calls of one actual current 98 loop, with two separately read contiguous directional sections and pickup-only start/dropoff-only end, are sufficient. Current qualified stop pages distinguish roadside/direction descriptors. Historical licensed P11 same-operator representative stops preserve their scope rather than asserting directional poles or new pedestrian crossings. Physical identity review uses exact government stop record, same historical 98 route context and current carrier stop-group evidence; record each qualified label and historical/current source bindings explicitly. No Ekitan/Jorudan data admitted, no reverse or route-union inference.
